title: Return a new item location
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Return a new item location. Inspect the Location header.
introduction: CreatedAtAction sends status 201 and a link to the new item. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Return a new item location with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Return a new item location

blocks.text: CreatedAtAction uses ById and id 1 to build a location. The submitted book is its response body.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The named action and route values must identify a real route.
